newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends barely changed in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends barely changed in tight trade.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed barely changed on Thursday as speculators were sidelines for fear of a sizeable remittance from overseas workers, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 57.09 to the dollar, after staying in a 57.02-57.10 range, they said.
"Despite some import covering demand for dollars, activity was ranged because speculators don't find the risk/return profile attractive," said an American Express Bank dealer.
Speculators believed the exchange rate could come down sharply with one substantial inward remittance, dealers said.
The Central Bank's buying and selling rates of 55.9870 and 57.1180 also helped limit the rupee's movement.
While upside was limited by the central bank buying rate, downside was over one rupee away, the American Express Bank dealer said.
The overnight call money rate closed at 13.25 prcent after opening at 13.50, dealers said.
